description: form to create a new habit with name, cadence, notes, target
spec:
1. Add a create-habit form using shadcn/ui inputs.
2. Require a name; cadence defaults to daily.
3. Allow optional notes and target.
4. Submit via the create hook and show the new habit in the list.
5. Validate empty name client-side before submit.
6. Reset the form after a successful create.
title: Add habit form
